reviewBasis: Launch-time harness snapshots and recorded outputs; untracked working-tree source at HEAD bd316cb326e5fbc20087c0154d6e3f294a5daac7. Hashes are pinned from each run sourceBefore; later shared-worktree edits are outside this review.

findings.finding: J launcher evidence is archived with producer phase6-g-browser-launcher.
findings.recommendation: Use a J-specific producer label in a later authorized change.

findings.finding: Both runs fail because the requested “等待 1 日” control is absent from the live “地圖與世界” UI; the screenshot shows “繼續時間”.
findings.recommendation: Align the action with the visible canonical control and verify it in a new short run before long runs.

findings.finding: Runner assigns generic PASS_J_BROWSER without requiring requested real duration, all required controlled lanes, or minimum periodic metric checkpoints; it also permits NORMAL_FRESH=UNREACHED under that pass label. Root aggregate can require at least one natural arc across the run set, so this finding concerns the runner pass label, not a requirement that each individual run complete the arc.
findings.recommendation: Use an explicit incomplete/non-pass per-run disposition when duration, required controls, or metric checkpoints are missing; require at least one natural fresh arc in the aggregate run set.

findings.finding: The checkpoint timer is first invoked after normal_lane returns (up to 180s); periodic save/reload is initialized as 300s from that later point. The first scheduled reload is therefore about 480s from actual normal-run start.
findings.recommendation: Anchor periodic checkpoint and save/reload cadence to actual normal-run start, as required by Root clarification.

evidenceGaps: No natural warning-to-aftermath arc or controlled fixture lanes executed.
20k exact-clone benchmark and browser-journal-growth measurement remain outside this review and pending.
The first scheduled save/reload is delayed by the 180-second normal warm-up because its timer starts afterward; both runs failed before it could run.
